verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show any first-party feature that lets a user operate AWS with natural-language commands. The AWS CLI uses structured commands with tab completion and prompting, which is not natural language. Bedrock and AgentCore are platforms for developers to build their own agents, so they are building blocks. The official open-source MCP servers are only named, with no documented natural-language operation, and they would need an external agent client to approximate the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
